web.description:
# Publishing to Native Platforms [​](https://docs.cocos.com/creator/3.8/manual/en/editor/publish/native-options.html#publishing-to-native-platforms)
Cocos Creator currently supports deployment to native platforms including **Android**, **iOS**, **Mac** and **Windows**.

## Other Build Options [​](https://docs.cocos.com/creator/3.8/manual/en/editor/publish/native-options.html#other-build-options)
[Build Options - Android](https://docs.cocos.com/creator/3.8/manual/en/editor/publish/android/build-options-android.html) [Build Options - iOS](https://docs.cocos.com/creator/3.8/manual/en/editor/publish/ios/build-options-ios.html) [Build Options - Windows](https://docs.cocos.com/creator/3.8/manual/en/editor/publish/windows/build-options-windows.html) [Build Options - macOS](https://docs.cocos.com/creator/3.8/manual/en/editor/publish/mac/build-options-mac.html)

## Compile and Run [​](https://docs.cocos.com/creator/3.8/manual/en/editor/publish/native-options.html#compile-and-run)
### Via Cocos Creator [​](https://docs.cocos.com/creator/3.8/manual/en/editor/publish/native-options.html#via-cocos-creator)
- iOS: Preview will be executed via a simulator, but it is recommended to execute on a device via Xcode.

### Via IDE [​](https://docs.cocos.com/creator/3.8/manual/en/editor/publish/native-options.html#via-ide)
- **Android**

![android xcode](https://docs.cocos.com/creator/3.8/manual/assets/android-studio.BfzeO1yO.png)

## Considerations [​](https://docs.cocos.com/creator/3.8/manual/en/editor/publish/native-options.html#considerations)
3. When building for Android, compilation output of Cocos Creator and Android Studio may differ in the following ways:
   - After the **Make** process is executed in Cocos Creator, the `build` folder will be generated in the release directory, and the .apk package will be generated in the `build\app\publish\` folder of the build directory.

web.title: Publish to Web Platforms
web.description:
# Publish to Web Platforms [​](https://docs.cocos.com/creator/3.8/manual/en/editor/publish/publish-web.html#publish-to-web-platforms)
Select **Project -> Build** from the main menu, and open the [Build](https://docs.cocos.com/creator/3.8/manual/en/editor/publish/build-panel.html) panel.

![web](https://docs.cocos.com/creator/3.8/manual/assets/web.De8bIaZq.png)

Cocos Creator provides two web platform page templates. Select **Web Mobile** or **Web Desktop** through the drop-down menu of **Platform**.

## Introduction to Build Options [​](https://docs.cocos.com/creator/3.8/manual/en/editor/publish/publish-web.html#introduction-to-build-options)
### Web Mobile [​](https://docs.cocos.com/creator/3.8/manual/en/editor/publish/publish-web.html#web-mobile)
| Build options | Description | Field name (for command line publishing) |
|-|-|-|
| Preview URL | Link for preview, see the introduction below for details | - |

- If **do not fill in**, the `remote` folder in the release package directory will be packaged into the built game package.
- If **fill in**, it will not be packaged into the game package. Developers need to manually upload the `remote` folder in the release package directory to the resource server address filled in after the build. For details, please refer to [Upload resources to a remote server](https://docs.cocos.com/creator/3.8/manual/en/asset/cache-manager.html).
- **Preview URL**

The build supports simultaneous previewing of multiple Web projects, so the preview URL to be built is no longer uniform, but each build task will have a separate preview URL, which does not interfere with each other. Click the URL to automatically open the browser for preview.

![preview-url](https://docs.cocos.com/creator/3.8/manual/assets/preview-url.BTJCLhMc.png)

## Build and Preview [​](https://docs.cocos.com/creator/3.8/manual/en/editor/publish/publish-web.html#build-and-preview)
After configuring the build options, click the **Build** button to start the web platform version build. When the progress bar shows **Build success**, the build is complete.

![web mobile](https://docs.cocos.com/creator/3.8/manual/assets/web-mobile.B_do3Ykh.png)

## Publish to Web Server [​](https://docs.cocos.com/creator/3.8/manual/en/editor/publish/publish-web.html#publish-to-web-server)
![web mobile](https://docs.cocos.com/creator/3.8/manual/assets/web-folder.DOz0XJjH.png)
